# HeroUI Native LLMs.txt Quick Reference Index

> Documentation for HeroUI Native component library.

HeroUI Native uses Tailwind v4 via Uniwind, with animations, accessibility, and customization.

## Key Features
- Beautiful by default
- Accessible
- Flexible
- Developer-friendly with typed APIs

## Components

- All Components: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components
- Button: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/button — triggers action on press
- CloseButton: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/close-button — closes dialogs/modals
- LinkButton: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/link-button — ghost variant, no highlight feedback, inline link-style
- Menu: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/menu — floating context menu with positioning, selection groups, multiple modes
- TagGroup: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/tag-group — compound component for selectable tags with optional removal
- Slider: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/slider — draggable input for value or range within bounds
- Switch: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/switch — toggle between on/off
- Chip: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/chip — compact capsule-shaped element
- Alert: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/alert — important messages with status indicators
- SkeletonGroup: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/skeleton-group — coordinates multiple skeleton placeholders with centralized animation
- Skeleton: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/skeleton — loading placeholder with shimmer/pulse
- Spinner: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/spinner — animated loading indicator
- Checkbox: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/checkbox — toggle checked/unchecked
- ControlField: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/control-field — combines label, description, and control (Switch/Checkbox) into single pressable area
- Description: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/description — accessible descriptions and helper text
- FieldError: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/field-error — validation error with smooth animations
- InputGroup: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/input-group — groups input with optional prefix/suffix decorators
- InputOTP: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/input-otp — OTP entry with individual character slots, animations, validation
- Input: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/input — text input with styled border and background
- Label: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/label — form field labeling with required indicators and validation states
- RadioGroup: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/radio-group — set of radio buttons, single selection
- SearchField: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/search-field — compound search input for filtering/querying
- Select: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/select — list of options triggered by button
- TextArea: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/text-area — multiline text input with styled border and background
- TextField: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/text-field — text input with label, description, error handling
- Card: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/card — card container with flexible layout sections
- Separator: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/separator — simple line for visual separation
- Surface: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/surface — container with elevation and background styling
- Avatar: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/avatar — user avatar with images, initials, or fallback icons
- Accordion: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/accordion — collapsible content panel
- ListGroup: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/list-group — Surface-based container grouping list items with consistent layout
- Tabs: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/tabs — tabbed views with animated transitions and indicators
- BottomSheet: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/bottom-sheet — slides up from bottom with animations and swipe-to-dismiss
- Dialog: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/dialog — modal overlay with animated transitions and gesture dismissal
- Popover: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/popover — floating content panel anchored to trigger with placement options
- Toast: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/toast — temporary notifications at top or bottom
- Typography: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/text — primitive for styled text with semantic type variants
- PressableFeedback: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/pressable-feedback — press interaction visual feedback with scale animation
- ScrollShadow: https://www.heroui.com/en/docs/native/components/scroll-shadow — dynamic gradient shadows based on scroll position
